title: Schema v2 migration: a once-only exception to record immutability
subject: schema-v2-migration-exception
ratio:
the immutable list grows by the four v2 fields -- `sources`, `validity_conditions`, `operation`,
`interpretive_code_version` -- and by `schema_version`; the mutable list is unchanged; PLUS one
narrowly stated exception: the once-only schema migration may, on a `schema_version` 1 record,
add exactly the four v2 fields and flip `schema_version` 1->2, altering no existing field value
byte-for-byte. No other in-place addition or rewrite is ever permitted; the exception is
structurally consumed once zero v1 records remain in the live root. SDR-01's declared reach
("immutable after publication", unqualified) was apparent; its real ratio -- published content is
never altered and lineage is append-only -- never extended to a pure format migration that adds
schema-mandated fields while preserving every existing byte. The correction restricts SDR-01's
reach to content alteration; it does not touch the mutable-fields list, which is unchanged.
scope_conditions: the four schema_version 1 records PR-001..PR-004 only
the migrate verb's single live-root run
revisit_trigger: Revisit if any schema_version 1 record ever reappears in the live root
validity_conditions: zero schema_version 1 records remain in the live root after T-355
